meta.title: Mark — Personal Site Publisher Mode
meta.description: Try Daymark in a throwaway WordPress. Lands in the /daymark app shell, logged in as admin.
meta.author: jeffpaul

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$plugin = Daymark_Plugin::instance();

foreach ( [ 'https://jeffpaul.com', 'https://jondesrosiers.com', 'https://aaron.jorb.in' ] as $site_url ) {
	$result = $plugin->subscriptions->subscribe_to_site( $site_url );
	if ( ! is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
		$plugin->subscription_poller->poll_subscription( (int) $result );
	}
}

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Seed a real, published Mark of each Daymark type (image, gallery, note,
// video, audio, mixed) so every Timeline card kind, per-type destination
// default, and the composer's edit path all have something real to test
// against on this throwaway install — not just the subscribed feeds above.
//
// Best-effort throughout: this is demo-data seeding for a "try it" preview,
// never something that should leave the whole install broken if one piece
// of it can't run in a given Playground environment (e.g. a php-wasm build
// missing a GD function). Each Mark publish is wrapped so one failure is
// skipped rather than aborting every remaining demo Mark.
$admin = get_user_by( 'login', 'admin' );
if ( ! $admin ) {
	$admins = get_users(
		array(
			'role'   => 'administrator',
			'number' => 1,
		)
	);
	$admin  = $admins[0] ?? null;
}

if ( $admin ) {
	wp_set_current_user( $admin->ID );
}

$publisher = Daymark_Plugin::instance()->publisher;

/**
 * Generate a small, real JPEG on disk (via GD) for a demo image attachment.
 * wp_handle_sideload() moves its source file rather than copying it, so
 * each attachment needs its own disposable file — never the same path twice.
 *
 * Returns null (rather than fataling) when GD isn't available, or doesn't
 * support JPEG output, in the current PHP runtime — a real constraint some
 * php-wasm builds have — so a demo Mark that needs a real file can be
 * skipped instead of crashing this whole seeding step.
 */
function daymark_demo_image_file(): ?string {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'imagecreatetruecolor' )
		|| ! function_exists( 'imagecolorallocate' )
		|| ! function_exists( 'imagefill' )
		|| ! function_exists( 'imagejpeg' )
		|| ! function_exists( 'imagedestroy' )
	) {
		return null;
	}

	$path  = wp_tempnam( 'daymark-demo-' ) . '.jpg';
	$image = imagecreatetruecolor( 640, 480 );

	if ( ! $image ) {
		return null;
	}

	$color = imagecolorallocate( $image, wp_rand( 40, 215 ), wp_rand( 40, 215 ), wp_rand( 40, 215 ) );
	imagefill( $image, 0, 0, $color );
	$wrote = imagejpeg( $image, $path, 82 );
	imagedestroy( $image );

	if ( ! $wrote || ! is_readable( $path ) || 0 === (int) filesize( $path ) ) {
		return null;
	}

	return $path;
}

/**
 * Build one $_FILES-style entry for a real file already on disk.
 *
 * @param string $path Path to a real, already-written file.
 * @param string $name Original filename to report (drives the extension check).
 * @param string $mime Reported MIME type.
 * @return array<string, mixed>
 */
function daymark_demo_file_entry( string $path, string $name, string $mime ): array {
	return array(
		'name'     => $name,
		'type'     => $mime,
		'tmp_name' => $path,
		'error'    => UPLOAD_ERR_OK,
		'size'     => filesize( $path ),
	);
}

/**
 * Assemble a $_FILES-shaped array (single field, 0+ files) from a flat list
 * of file entries, matching Daymark_Publisher::normalize_files()'s expected
 * transposed shape for a multi-file field.
 *
 * @param array<int, array<string, mixed>> $entries File entries.
 * @return array<string, array<string, array<int, mixed>>>
 */
function daymark_demo_files( array $entries ): array {
	if ( ! $entries ) {
		return array();
	}

	return array(
		'daymark_media' => array(
			'name'     => wp_list_pluck( $entries, 'name' ),
			'type'     => wp_list_pluck( $entries, 'type' ),
			'tmp_name' => wp_list_pluck( $entries, 'tmp_name' ),
			'error'    => wp_list_pluck( $entries, 'error' ),
			'size'     => wp_list_pluck( $entries, 'size' ),
		),
	);
}

// Video and audio deliberately carry no real attached file: fabricating a
// genuine playable video/audio container isn't worth the fragility here,
// and a media-less Mark of either type already renders correctly on the
// Timeline via its own type-specific placeholder icon (see CLAUDE.md's
// "Timeline card media slot dropped entirely when there's nothing to show").
//
// Image/gallery/mixed demo Marks need a real generated image; when GD can't
// produce one in this environment, that demo Mark is skipped entirely
// (`null` file => the whole entry is dropped below) rather than publishing
// a broken or empty file reference.
$demo_image       = daymark_demo_image_file();
$demo_gallery_one = daymark_demo_image_file();
$demo_gallery_two = daymark_demo_image_file();
$demo_mixed_image = daymark_demo_image_file();

$demo_marks = array();

if ( null !== $demo_image ) {
	$demo_marks[] = array(
		'caption' => 'A quiet afternoon walk. Sample Image Mark for testing.',
		'files'   => array( daymark_demo_file_entry( $demo_image, 'demo-image.jpg', 'image/jpeg' ) ),
	);
}

if ( null !== $demo_gallery_one && null !== $demo_gallery_two ) {
	$demo_marks[] = array(
		'caption' => 'Three from today. Sample Gallery Mark for testing.',
		'files'   => array(
			daymark_demo_file_entry( $demo_gallery_one, 'demo-gallery-1.jpg', 'image/jpeg' ),
			daymark_demo_file_entry( $demo_gallery_two, 'demo-gallery-2.jpg', 'image/jpeg' ),
		),
	);
}

$demo_marks[] = array(
	'caption' => 'Just thinking out loud. Sample Note Mark for testing.',
	'files'   => array(),
);

$demo_marks[] = array(
	'caption'      => 'A clip from today. Sample Video Mark for testing.',
	'files'        => array(),
	'primary_type' => 'video',
);

$demo_marks[] = array(
	'caption'      => 'A recording from today. Sample Audio Mark for testing.',
	'files'        => array(),
	'primary_type' => 'audio',
);

if ( null !== $demo_mixed_image ) {
	$demo_marks[] = array(
		'caption'      => 'A bit of everything. Sample Mixed Mark for testing.',
		'files'        => array( daymark_demo_file_entry( $demo_mixed_image, 'demo-mixed.jpg', 'image/jpeg' ) ),
		'primary_type' => 'mixed',
	);
}

foreach ( $demo_marks as $mark ) {
	$data = array( 'caption' => $mark['caption'] );

	if ( ! empty( $mark['primary_type'] ) ) {
		$data['primary_type'] = $mark['primary_type'];
	}

	try {
		$publisher->publish( $data, daymark_demo_files( $mark['files'] ) );
	} catch ( \Throwable $e ) {
		// Best-effort demo seeding: one Mark failing to publish in a given
		// Playground environment should never take down the rest of this
		// step (or the whole "try it" preview) with it.
		continue;
	}
}
